54:50.text: And Our command is but one, like a glance of the eye.

54:51.text: And We have already destroyed your kinds,
so is there any who will remember?

54:52.text: And everything they did is in written records.

54:54.text: Indeed, the righteous will be among gardens and rivers,

54:55.text: In a seat of honor near a Sovereign, Perfect in Ability.

55:6.text: And the stars and trees prostrate.

55:7.text: And the heaven He raised and imposed the balance

55:8.text: That you not transgress within the balance.

55:9.text: And establish weight in justice and do not make deficient the balance.

55:11.text: Therein is fruit and palm trees having sheaths

55:12.text: And grain having husks and scented plants.

55:13.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

55:14.text: He created man from clay like

55:15.text: And He created the jinn from a smokeless flame of fire.

55:16.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
